+---
+docs_token: DOCS_TOKEN_INTELLIGENCE_CONTEXT_ADMISSION_AND_ORIGINAL_DERIVATIONS_V1
+status: active
+scope: Explicit offline MI context admission; no productive activation
+---
+
+# Intelligence context admission and original derivations
+
+This is an additive implementation contract subordinate to the existing Track D
+owners. It grants no runtime, trading, selection, capital or promotion authority.
+
+The existing Phase18/19 materializer now optionally exposes a copied derivation
+sidecar keyed by its original state references. Native records, IDs, decimal text
+and equations remain unchanged. Price, flow, OHLCV proxy, volatility, derivatives
+and cross-market calculations are still performed by their original functions.
+The sidecar resolves numbers already computed there; it is not a second fact SSOT.
+
+The local Attach bridge accepts only the existing boolean-false offline pins.
+Boolean true, integer zero, None and strings fail closed. No global pin is changed.
+
+## Explicit consumer
+
+`compose_admitted_intelligence_context_v1` composes the existing materializer after
+checking original payload bytes, original digest, source reference, generation,
+canonical/native instrument and venue, actual capture, declared knowledge and
+availability time, final interval availability, quality, finite numbers and units.
+The source receipts are caller-provided evidence, not venue authentication.
+Missing original capture or source metadata rejects rather than inventing history.
+
+Every used fact requires exactly one receipt; unused receipts reject. A receipt
+may be shared when the same original fact is used in multiple named roles.
+Freshness limits and required families are explicit caller policy with no defaults.
+Series must be contiguous PT1M and duplicate-free; selected/anchor grids must match.
+OI levels must have compatible units and distinct timestamps. Trade notional and
+OHLCV proxy inputs require base quantities; contract quantities are not silently
+converted. Funding requires an explicit rate-period unit. There is no annualization.
+
+All original source JSON bytes, hashes, times and units are retained as evidence
+with the native context and copied derivation bodies. Hash binding proves integrity,
+not natural provenance. An immutable full identity binds source generation, venue,
+instrument, native mapping, lane, epoch and decision. Lane IDs identify exactly the
+five existing slots and confer no position capacity.
+
+## Equations and limits
+
+Cross-market keeps the original formula `(selected-anchor)-beta*anchor`; it is not
+renamed or changed into `selected-beta*anchor`. The native derived payload and
+version make that meaning inspectable. Volatility, Scope and their parameters are
+unchanged. Proxy microstructure remains PROXY_OHLCV, not L2.
+
+Without an explicitly admitted provider the output is ABSTAIN with
+NO_ADMITTED_FORECAST_PROVIDER. Missing required context gives INSUFFICIENT and
+ABSTAIN/MISSING_REQUIRED_FAMILIES, without numeric zero substitution or a dummy
+ForecastEvidence. This callable offline composition does not register a service,
+schedule a job, touch productive financial owners or supply a model by inference.
+
+Forecast execution/quality, measured research feature influence, GVEF quality and
+the explicit Governance receiver remain separate interfaces and proofs. A new
+integration function is not evidence that the productive host calls it.
+
+Tests: [context admission](../../../tests/learning/test_intelligence_context_admission_v1.py),
+[original materializer](../../../tests/learning/test_market_context_existing_fact_materialization_v1.py),
+[Phase19](../../../tests/learning/test_market_context_phase_19_orthogonal_materialization_v1.py).

+"""Validated read-only context composition over the original Phase18/19 owners.
+
+Receipts bind source bytes and consumer-specific policy; they do not authenticate a
+venue or create a second fact store. No implicit unit conversion or model selection.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import math
+from typing import Any, Mapping, Sequence
+
+from .integration_contracts_v1 import (
+    IntelligenceIdentityV1,
+    assert_offline_v1,
+    bytes_v1,
+    instant_v1,
+    require_v1,
+    seal_v1,
+    strict_json_v1,
+    text_v1,
+)
+from .market_context_existing_fact_materialization_v1 import (
+    ExistingFactMaterializationRequestV1,
+    GovernedCanonicalFactV1,
+    materialize_market_context_v1_from_existing_facts_v1,
+)
+from .market_context_phase_19_orthogonal_materialization_v1 import (
+    validate_phase_19_canonical_fact_v1,
+)
+
+CONTEXT_PACKAGE_SCHEMA = "admitted_intelligence_context_v1"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FactAdmissionReceiptV1:
+    source_ref: str
+    dataset_generation: str
+    payload_bytes: bytes
+    known_at: str
+    available_at: str
+    units: Mapping[str, str]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ContextAdmissionPolicyV1:
+    """Explicit per-use freshness limits; no global TTL, units or default forecast."""
+
+    policy_ref: str
+    max_age_seconds_by_role: Mapping[str, int]
+    required_families: Sequence[str]
+
+
+def _fact_groups(request):
+    groups = {
+        "price_mark": (request.price_mark_fact,) if request.price_mark_fact else (),
+        "price_o4": (request.price_o4_bar_fact,) if request.price_o4_bar_fact else (),
+        "flow": request.trade_facts or (),
+        "microstructure": request.ohlcv_facts or (),
+        "volatility": request.volatility_mark_facts or (),
+    }
+    if request.phase_19 is not None:
+        p = request.phase_19
+        for role, fact in (
+            ("derivatives_mark", p.derivatives_mark_fact),
+            ("derivatives_index", p.derivatives_index_fact),
+            ("derivatives_last", p.derivatives_last_fact),
+            ("funding", p.funding_rate_fact),
+        ):
+            groups[role] = (fact,) if fact is not None else ()
+        groups["open_interest"] = p.open_interest_facts or ()
+        groups["cross_selected"] = p.cross_market_selected_marks or ()
+        for ref, facts in (p.cross_market_anchor_marks_by_ref or {}).items():
+            text_v1(ref, "ANCHOR_INSTRUMENT")
+            groups["anchor:" + ref] = facts
+    return groups
+
+
+def _identity_and_time(fact, identity, expected_instrument):
+    p = fact.payload
+    if fact.fact_kind == "FinalizedPt1hO4BarFactV1":
+        bar = p["bar"]
+        actual = (bar.get("canonical_instrument_id"), bar.get("venue"))
+        native = bar.get("venue_instrument_id")
+        event = datetime.fromtimestamp(bar["bar_close_time"], timezone.utc)
+        interval_end = event
+    else:
+        instrument = p.get("instrument", {})
+        actual = (instrument.get("canonical_instrument_id"), instrument.get("venue"))
+        native = instrument.get("venue_native_id")
+        ts = p.get("timestamps", {})
+        event = instant_v1(ts.get("effective_at") or ts.get("captured_at"))
+        interval_end = event
+        if fact.fact_kind in {"FinalizedPt1mMarkFactV1", "OhlcvIntervalFactV1"}:
+            ms = p.get("interval_start_ms")
+            require_v1(type(ms) is int and ms % 60000 == 0, "PT1M_GRID_REQUIRED")
+            if fact.fact_kind == "OhlcvIntervalFactV1":
+                require_v1(p.get("interval_id") == "PT1M", "UNSUPPORTED_OHLCV_GRID")
+            event = datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000, timezone.utc)
+            interval_end = datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000 + 60, timezone.utc)
+    require_v1(actual == (expected_instrument, identity.venue), "FACT_ENTITY_MISMATCH")
+    text_v1(native, "NATIVE_INSTRUMENT")
+    if expected_instrument == identity.instrument_ref:
+        require_v1(native == identity.native_instrument_ref, "NATIVE_INSTRUMENT_MISMATCH")
+    return native, event, interval_end
+
+
+def _validate_numbers_and_units(fact, receipt):
+    p = fact.payload
+    units = dict(receipt.units)
+    require_v1(bool(units), "EXPLICIT_UNITS_REQUIRED")
+    for key, value in units.items():
+        text_v1(key, "UNIT_FIELD")
+        text_v1(value, "UNIT_SEMANTICS")
+        require_v1(value not in {"UNKNOWN", "MIXED"}, "UNIT_UNKNOWN")
+    fields = {
+        "FinalizedPt1mMarkFactV1": ("mark_px",),
+        "MarkPriceFactV1": ("mark_px",),
+        "IndexPriceFactV1": ("index_px",),
+        "LastTradePriceFactV1": ("last_px",),
+        "TradeFactV1": ("price", "size"),
+        "OhlcvIntervalFactV1": ("open_px", "high_px", "low_px", "close_px", "volume"),
+        "FundingRateFactV1": ("funding_rate",),
+        "OpenInterestFactV1": ("open_interest",),
+        "FinalizedPt1hO4BarFactV1": ("close",),
+    }.get(fact.fact_kind)
+    require_v1(fields is not None, "UNSUPPORTED_FACT_KIND")
+    source = p["bar"] if fact.fact_kind == "FinalizedPt1hO4BarFactV1" else p
+    for field in fields:
+        raw = source.get(field)
+        require_v1(type(raw) in (str, int, float), "NATIVE_NUMERIC_VALUE_REQUIRED")
+        try:
+            value = float(raw)
+        except (ValueError, OverflowError) as exc:
+            raise ValueError("NATIVE_NUMERIC_VALUE_INVALID") from exc
+        require_v1(math.isfinite(value), "FINITE_FACT_REQUIRED")
+        if field not in {"funding_rate", "size", "volume", "open_interest"}:
+            require_v1(value > 0, "POSITIVE_PRICE_REQUIRED")
+        elif field != "funding_rate":
+            require_v1(value >= 0, "NONNEGATIVE_QUANTITY_REQUIRED")
+    if "funding_rate" in fields:
+        require_v1(units.get("funding_rate", "").startswith("RATE_PER:"), "FUNDING_PERIOD_REQUIRED")
+    elif "open_interest" in fields:
+        require_v1(bool(units.get("open_interest")), "OI_UNIT_REQUIRED")
+    else:
+        require_v1(bool(units.get("price")), "PRICE_UNIT_REQUIRED")
+    if "size" in fields:
+        require_v1(units.get("size") == "BASE", "NO_IMPLICIT_CONTRACT_NOTIONAL_CONVERSION")
+    if "volume" in fields:
+        require_v1(
+            units.get("volume") == "BASE" and p.get("volume_unit_semantics") == "base",
+            "NO_IMPLICIT_VOLUME_CONVERSION",
+        )
+    return units
+
+
+def compose_admitted_intelligence_context_v1(
+    *,
+    identity: IntelligenceIdentityV1,
+    request: ExistingFactMaterializationRequestV1,
+    receipts_by_digest: Mapping[str, FactAdmissionReceiptV1],
+    policy: ContextAdmissionPolicyV1,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Admission → original formulas → resolvable sidecar → explicit no-provider abstention."""
+    assert_offline_v1()
+    identity_body = identity.payload()
+    require_v1(request.instrument_ref == identity.instrument_ref, "REQUEST_ENTITY_MISMATCH")
+    text_v1(policy.policy_ref, "ADMISSION_POLICY")
+    require_v1(bool(policy.required_families), "REQUIRED_FAMILIES_POLICY_REQUIRED")
+    as_of = instant_v1(request.observed_at)
+    bindings = []
+    used = set()
+    instrument_units = {}
+    native_refs = {}
+    for role, facts in _fact_groups(request).items():
+        expected = (
+            role.removeprefix("anchor:") if role.startswith("anchor:") else identity.instrument_ref
+        )
+        events = []
+        hashes = set()
+        limit = policy.max_age_seconds_by_role.get(role)
+        if facts:
+            require_v1(type(limit) is int and limit >= 0, "ROLE_FRESHNESS_POLICY_REQUIRED")
+        for fact in facts:
+            require_v1(isinstance(fact, GovernedCanonicalFactV1), "GOVERNED_FACT_REQUIRED")
+            validate_phase_19_canonical_fact_v1(fact, observed_at=request.observed_at)
+            receipt = receipts_by_digest.get(fact.fact_digest)
+            require_v1(receipt is not None, "FACT_ADMISSION_RECEIPT_MISSING")
+            text_v1(receipt.source_ref, "SOURCE_REF")
+            require_v1(

+"""Additive offline integration bindings. Existing identity/hash domains are unchanged."""

+from __future__ import annotations

+from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+
+class IntelligenceIntegrationError(ValueError):
+    """A concrete offline consumer contract cannot be satisfied."""
+
+
+def require_v1(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise IntelligenceIntegrationError(reason)
+
+
+def text_v1(value: Any, name: str) -> str:
+    require_v1(isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()), f"{name}_REQUIRED")
+    return value
+
+
+def instant_v1(value: str) -> datetime:
+    text_v1(value, "UTC_INSTANT")
+    try:
+        result = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        require_v1(result.utcoffset() is not None, "UTC_OFFSET_REQUIRED")
+        require_v1(result.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0, "UTC_REQUIRED")
+        return result.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise IntelligenceIntegrationError("UTC_INSTANT_INVALID") from exc
+
+
+def finite_v1(value: Any, name: str) -> float:
+    require_v1(type(value) in (int, float), f"{name}_NUMERIC_REQUIRED")
+    require_v1(math.isfinite(value), f"{name}_FINITE_REQUIRED")
+    return float(value)
+
+
+def plain_v1(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        require_v1(all(isinstance(k, str) for k in value), "STRING_KEYS_REQUIRED")
+        return {k: plain_v1(v) for k, v in value.items()}
+    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
+        return [plain_v1(v) for v in value]
+    require_v1(type(value) in (type(None), str, int, bool, float), "JSON_VALUE_REQUIRED")
+    if type(value) is float:
+        finite_v1(value, "JSON_FLOAT")
+    return value
+
+
+def bytes_v1(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    """Versioned exact JSON values, including full float repr; no .12g normalization."""
+    return json.dumps(
+        plain_v1(value),
+        sort_keys=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+        ensure_ascii=True,
+        allow_nan=False,
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def digest_v1(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(bytes_v1(value)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def strict_json_v1(data: bytes) -> Any:
+    def pairs(items):
+        require_v1(len(items) == len({k for k, v in items}), "DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY")
+        return dict(items)
+
+    def constant(value):
+        raise IntelligenceIntegrationError("NONFINITE_JSON_NUMBER")
+
+    try:
+        return json.loads(data, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=constant)
+    except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
+        raise IntelligenceIntegrationError("ORIGINAL_JSON_INVALID") from exc
+
+
+def seal_v1(body: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = plain_v1(body)
+    require_v1("exact_content_digest" not in result, "ALREADY_SEALED")
+    return {**result, "exact_content_digest": digest_v1(result)}
+
+
+def validate_seal_v1(record: Mapping[str, Any], schema: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = plain_v1(record)
+    digest = result.pop("exact_content_digest", None)
+    require_v1(result.get("schema_version") == schema, "INTEGRATION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH")
+    require_v1(digest == digest_v1(result), "EXACT_CONTENT_MISMATCH")
+    require_v1(result.get("authority") == "NONE", "INTEGRATION_AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN")
+    return {**result, "exact_content_digest": digest}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class IntelligenceIdentityV1:
+    """Full context identity; lane is one of five slots, never position authority."""
+
+    dataset_generation: str
+    venue: str
+    instrument_ref: str
+    native_instrument_ref: str
+    lane_id: str
+    epoch: str
+    decision_event_ref: str
+
+    def payload(self) -> dict[str, str]:
+        body = asdict(self)
+        for key, value in body.items():
+            text_v1(value, key)
+        require_v1(self.lane_id in {f"LANE_{i}" for i in range(1, 6)}, "FIVE_SLOT_ID_REQUIRED")
+        return body
+
+
+def assert_offline_v1() -> None:
+    from . import constants_v1 as pins
+
+    require_v1(pins.RUNTIME_REACHABILITY is False, "OFFLINE_ONLY")

+    require_v1(pins.LEARNING_TRADING_AUTHORITY == "NONE", "SL_AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN")
+    require_v1(pins.OPTIMIZATION_PRODUCTIVE_AUTHORITY == "NONE", "OPT_AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN")

+            "venue_native_id": IDENTITY.native_instrument_ref,
+        },
+        "timestamps": {
+            "effective_at": dt.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+            "captured_at": (dt + timedelta(seconds=61)).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+        },
+        "quality": {"finalized": True, "missing": False},
+    }
+    return GovernedCanonicalFactV1(
+        payload["fact_kind"], fact_digest(payload), payload, WP_A_PRODUCER
+    )

+def inputs(*, volatility=False):
+    facts = [mark(i, str(100 * math.exp(0.001 * i))) for i in range(61)] if volatility else [mark()]
+    request = ExistingFactMaterializationRequestV1(
+        observed_at=(BASE + timedelta(minutes=62)).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+        instrument_ref=IDENTITY.instrument_ref,
+        provenance_refs=("prov.original",),
+        price_mark_fact=facts[-1],
+        volatility_mark_facts=facts if volatility else None,
+    )
+    receipts = {
+        f.fact_digest: FactAdmissionReceiptV1(
+            "original." + f.fact_digest,
+            IDENTITY.dataset_generation,
+            bytes_v1(f.payload),
+            f.payload["timestamps"]["captured_at"],
+            f.payload["timestamps"]["captured_at"],
+            {"price": "USDT_PER_SUI"},
+        )
+        for f in facts
+    }
+    return dict(
+        identity=IDENTITY,
+        request=request,
+        receipts_by_digest=receipts,
+        policy=ContextAdmissionPolicyV1(
+            "explicit.synthetic.policy",
+            {"price_mark": 120, "volatility": 120},
+            ("price_state_ref",),
+        ),
+    )

+def test_original_ids_values_and_inputs_survive_sidecar_and_abstention():

+    "change,reason",
+    [
+        ("late", "LOOKAHEAD"),
+        ("generation", "GENERATION"),
+        ("bytes", "BYTES"),
+        ("stale", "STALE"),
+        ("native", "NATIVE"),
+        ("instrument", "ENTITY"),
+        ("unit", "UNIT"),
+        ("nonfinite", "FINITE"),
+        ("not_available", "NOT_AVAILABLE"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_bad_fact_or_receipt_never_reaches_numeric_success(change, reason):
+    args = inputs()
+    fact = args["request"].price_mark_fact
+    receipt = args["receipts_by_digest"][fact.fact_digest]
+    if change == "late":
+        receipt = replace(receipt, available_at="2026-06-02T00:00:00Z")
+    if change == "generation":
+        receipt = replace(receipt, dataset_generation="generation.foreign")
+    if change == "bytes":
+        receipt = replace(receipt, payload_bytes=b"{}")
+    if change == "stale":
+        args["policy"] = replace(args["policy"], max_age_seconds_by_role={"price_mark": 1})
+    if change == "unit":
+        receipt = replace(receipt, units={"price": "UNKNOWN"})
+    if change == "not_available":
+        receipt = replace(
+            receipt, known_at="2026-06-01T01:00:00Z", available_at="2026-06-01T01:00:00Z"
+        )
+    if change in {"native", "instrument", "nonfinite"}:
+        p = deepcopy(fact.payload)
+        if change == "native":
+            p["instrument"]["venue_native_id"] = "FOREIGN"
+        if change == "instrument":
+            p["instrument"]["canonical_instrument_id"] = "inst.foreign"
+        if change == "nonfinite":
+            p["mark_px"] = "NaN"
+        fact = replace(fact, payload=p, fact_digest=fact_digest(p))
+        args["request"] = replace(args["request"], price_mark_fact=fact)
+        receipt = replace(receipt, payload_bytes=bytes_v1(p))
+    args["receipts_by_digest"] = {fact.fact_digest: receipt}
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=reason):
+        compose_admitted_intelligence_context_v1(**args)
